name: exploded-portafilter-claude-haiku-5.5-s2-r1
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an espresso machine portafilter, as an SVG. Use a double-spout portafilter with a removable basket rather than a bottomless one.

grade.detail: passed what it measured; left to the eye: parts, order, fit, axis, labels

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="720" viewBox="0 0 1000 720" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
<rect width="1000" height="720" fill="#ffffff"/>
<text x="500" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" font-weight="bold">Espresso Portafilter - Exploded Assembly</text>
<text x="500" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#555">Double-spout head with removable filter basket (side elevation)</text>

<!-- assembly axis -->
<line x1="420" y1="82" x2="420" y2="595" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="8,4"/>
<!-- alignment guides for screws and basket -->
<line x1="400" y1="232" x2="400" y2="262" stroke="#999" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
<line x1="440" y1="232" x2="440" y2="262" stroke="#999" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
<line x1="420" y1="372" x2="420" y2="426" stroke="#999" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>

<!-- 1 Handle -->
<g stroke="#222" stroke-width="2">
  <path d="M440,110 L860,116 Q890,120 890,130 Q890,140 860,144 L440,150 Z" fill="#8a5a3c"/>
  <circle cx="420" cy="130" r="34" fill="#bcbcbc"/>
  <circle cx="400" cy="130" r="4" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="440" cy="130" r="4" fill="#fff"/>
</g>

<!-- 2 Handle screws (exploded below handle) -->
<g stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" fill="#777">
  <rect x="391" y="196" width="18" height="8" rx="2"/>
  <rect x="396" y="204" width="8" height="28"/>
  <rect x="431" y="196" width="18" height="8" rx="2"/>
  <rect x="436" y="204" width="8" height="28"/>
</g>

<!-- 3 Portafilter head / body -->
<g stroke="#222" stroke-width="2">
  <rect x="350" y="260" width="140" height="12" fill="#9aa3ad"/>
  <rect x="330" y="272" width="180" height="98" rx="10" fill="#c9ced6"/>
  <rect x="316" y="296" width="16" height="22" rx="3" fill="#9aa3ad"/>
  <rect x="508" y="296" width="16" height="22" rx="3" fill="#9aa3ad"/>
</g>

<!-- 4 Double spouts (opposing lips on head rim) -->
<g stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" fill="#aab3bd">
  <polygon points="330,345 282,366 282,384 330,370"/>
  <polygon points="510,345 558,366 558,384 510,370"/>
</g>

<!-- 5 Removable filter basket (exploded below head) -->
<g stroke="#222" stroke-width="2">
  <rect x="334" y="428" width="172" height="12" rx="3" fill="#dcdfe3"/>
  <path d="M342,440 L498,440 L488,540 L352,540 Z" fill="#e7e9ec"/>
</g>
<g fill="#fff" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1">
  <circle cx="372" cy="464" r="3"/><circle cx="396" cy="464" r="3"/><circle cx="420" cy="464" r="3"/><circle cx="444" cy="464" r="3"/><circle cx="468" cy="464" r="3"/>
  <circle cx="366" cy="492" r="3"/><circle cx="390" cy="492" r="3"/><circle cx="414" cy="492" r="3"/><circle cx="438" cy="492" r="3"/><circle cx="462" cy="492" r="3"/><circle cx="484" cy="492" r="3"/>
  <circle cx="362" cy="520" r="3"/><circle cx="386" cy="520" r="3"/><circle cx="410" cy="520" r="3"/><circle cx="434" cy="520" r="3"/><circle cx="458" cy="520" r="3"/><circle cx="478" cy="520" r="3"/>
</g>

<!-- callouts -->
<g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none">
  <line x1="892" y1="132" x2="917" y2="130"/>
  <line x1="607" y1="215" x2="450" y2="206"/>
  <line x1="626" y1="300" x2="512" y2="300"/>
  <line x1="213" y1="352" x2="280" y2="368"/>
  <line x1="626" y1="470" x2="506" y2="470"/>
</g>
<g font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">
  <circle cx="930" cy="130" r="13" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="930" y="135">1</text>
  <circle cx="620" cy="215" r="13" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="620" y="220">2</text>
  <circle cx="640" cy="300" r="13" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="640" y="305">3</text>
  <circle cx="200" cy="352" r="13" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="200" y="357">4</text>
  <circle cx="640" cy="470" r="13" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="640" y="475">5</text>
</g>

<!-- parts list -->
<line x1="60" y1="588" x2="940" y2="588" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
<g font-size="14" fill="#111">
  <text x="60" y="614"><tspan font-weight="bold">1</tspan>   Handle (grip with mounting boss)</text>
  <text x="60" y="638"><tspan font-weight="bold">2</tspan>   Handle screws (x2), pass into head lugs</text>
  <text x="60" y="662"><tspan font-weight="bold">3</tspan>   Portafilter head / body with bayonet lugs</text>
  <text x="520" y="614"><tspan font-weight="bold">4</tspan>   Double spouts (opposing, integral to head)</text>
  <text x="520" y="638"><tspan font-weight="bold">5</tspan>   Filter basket, perforated, removable</text>
  <text x="520" y="662" fill="#555" font-size="12">Basket drops into head and is removed by inverting and tapping.</text>
</g>
</svg>
